chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad al-ʿAlawī, from al-ʿAmrakī al-Khurāsānī, from ʿAlī ibn Jaʿfar, from his brother Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام, who said:

I asked him about a mukātab who put out the eye of a mukātab or broke his tooth—what is upon him? He said: «If he has paid half of his mukātabah, then his indemnity is the indemnity of a free man; and if it is less than half, then it is according to the measure of how much of him has been freed. And likewise if he put out the eye of a free man.»

And I asked him about a free man who put out the eye of a mukātab or broke his tooth. He said: «If he has paid half of his mukātabah, the eye of the free man is to be put out in retaliation, or its indemnity if it was a mistake; he is in the position of a free man. But if he has not paid half, he is to be assessed and payment made according to the measure of what has been freed of him.»

And I asked him about the mukātab who, when he has paid half of what is upon him—he said: «He is in the position of a free man in the legal punishments and other than that, whether killing or otherwise.»

And I asked him about a mukātab who put out the eye of a mamlūk, while he had paid half of his mukātabah. He said: «The mamlūk is to be evaluated, and the mukātab pays to the master of the mamlūk half of his price.»

key_terms.الْحُدُودِ: Prescribed legal punishments in Islamic law.
key_terms.دِيَةُ حُرٍّ: The indemnity equivalent to that of a free man.
key_terms.دِيَتُهُ: His indemnity payment for bodily injury.
key_terms.قُوِّمَ: He is appraised or assessed for valuation.
key_terms.مُكَاتَبٍ: A slave under a manumission contract who purchases his freedom in installments.
key_terms.مُكَاتَبَتِهِ: His manumission contract and the payments due under it.

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a mukātab injures someone or is injured after paying half of his mukātabah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives legal rulings concerning retaliation and indemnity involving a mukātab, whose legal status changes according to how much of his manumission contract he has paid. Once he has paid half, he is treated like a free person in legal punishments and bodily injury cases; if less than half, liability is calculated in proportion to the degree of freedom attained.
